results.text: Exendin-4 and sitagliptin protect kidney from ischemia-reperfusion injury through suppressing oxidative stress and inflammatory reaction. This study tested the hypothesis that exendin-4 and sitagliptin can effectively protect kidney from acute ischemia-reperfusion (IR) injury.

results.text: Alogliptin attenuates STZ-induced diabetic nephropathy in rats through the modulation of autophagy, apoptosis, and inflammation pathways: Targeting NF-κB and AMPK/mTOR pathway. Diabetic nephropathy (DN) is a type of microvascular complication that arises from diabetes mellitus and leads to further health issues.
